notes: MetroGraph market-sizing Phase C extraction: 47 metrics (23 TAM, 24 CAGR) from 31 analyst sources across database visualization, graph databases, BI/analytics ecosystem, data engineering, and adjacent verticals. Core TAM segments: (1) Data Visualization: $10.9B-$18.4B (2025-2030, 10.95% CAGR); (2) Graph Databases: $0.51B-$2.14B (2024-2030, 27.1% CAGR) expanding to $25.23B by 2035 (21-27% CAGR); (3) Business Intelligence: $50.4B-$95.8B (2026-2033, 9.6% CAGR); (4) Data Engineering Services: $119.98B (2025, 24.13% CAGR); (5) Enterprise Data Viz: $10.22B-$18.99B (2025-2030, 13.2% CAGR); (6) Self-Service Analytics: $4.82B-$17.52B (2024-2033, 15.9% CAGR); (7) Database Tools: $13.2B-$22.8B (2025-2033, 7.1% CAGR); (8) Semantic/Knowledge Graphs: $1.45B-$3.66B core (2023-2030, 14.2% CAGR), enterprise $19.61B by 2035 (21.1% CAGR); (9) Data Integration: $15.18B-$30.27B (2026-2030, 12.1% CAGR); (10) Augmented Analytics: $31-37B (2026, 25-30% CAGR); (11) Embedded Analytics: $44-97B (2026, 10-16% CAGR); (12) IoT Analytics: $49.36B-$131.12B (2026-2031, 21.58% CAGR); (13) Data Observability: $1.91B-$6.94B (2025-2034, 15.39% CAGR); (14) Data Governance/Metadata: $4.60B-$9.68B (2026-2031, 16.05% CAGR), metadata subset 20-26% CAGR; (15) Low-Code/No-Code: $44.5B (2026, 19% CAGR). Cross-cutting macro trends: Cloud dominance 50-63%, AI/ML integration acceleration, real-time analytics, semantic layers, data democratization (80% of employees seeking self-service), natural language interfaces (40% demand), multi-cloud adoption (80% of enterprises). Geography: North America 37% share, APAC 11-21% CAGR growth. Critical trend: Data literacy gap affects 83% of organizations, driving need for intuitive visualization tools. Bottom-up SAM calculation for MetroGraph ICP (SMB/mid-market, 150k+ BI/analytics tool users): $5-50k per seat annually = $750M-$7.5B addressable segment. Top-down TAM: $150B+ broader analytics/BI ecosystem, with database visualization at $10.9B-$18.4B and graph databases as fastest-growing subsegment (27% CAGR). Sources: Tier-1 analyst firms (Gartner, Forrester), Tier-2 specialist market researchers (MarketsandMarkets, Mordor Intelligence, Grand View Research, Allied Market Research), Tier-3 vendor reports and surveys; funding databases (Crunchbase, Dealroom, PitchBook); practitioner surveys (BARC). Data as of 2025-2026.
